title: Human Judgment Before Consequential Execution
titleZh: 人类判断应位于具有现实后果的系统执行之前

corePosition.en: Human judgment should precede consequential system execution.
corePosition.zh: 人类判断应位于具有现实后果的系统执行之前。

abstract.en: This public research position states that human judgment should retain a real and structurally meaningful position before system actions produce consequential real-world effects.
abstract.zh: 本公开研究立场提出：在系统行为产生具有现实意义的后果之前，人类判断应保有真实且具有结构意义的位置。

publicResearchBoundary.en: This record establishes a public research position and does not disclose implementation methods, decision thresholds, intervention logic, governance procedures, software architecture, or operational workflows.
publicResearchBoundary.zh: 本记录用于确立公开研究立场，不公开实施方法、判断阈值、介入逻辑、治理程序、软件架构或执行流程。
